title: justpvp
description: Vanilla+ Texture Pack that add simple pvp-related tweaks
body:
# **JustPvP Resource Pack**
## **What this Pack Does**
This resource pack changes the textures in Minecraft to make your game look cleaner and improve your vision. It updates the looks of your gear, simplifies screen overlays, and highlights important blocks.
### **Main Features**
- **Recolored desaturated armor and tools**
- **Ore Outlines**: Adds an Outline to Ores so you can spot them easier
- **Clear Water**: Makes water see through
- **Clear Pumpkin Overlay**: Removes most of the annoying blur when wearing a pumpkin
- **Powder Snow Outline**: Adds a light blue outline to Powder Snow
- **Small Totem & Shield**: Lowers the size of the totem and shield so they don't block your view
- **Cobweb Outline**: Adds an Outline around the Cobwebs Hitbox
- **Low Fire**: Lowers the size of fire
- **Custom Menu Panorama**: Adds a beautiful background to the Main menu
- **Transparent GUIs**: Makes things like your inventory see-through
- **Suspicious Sand and Gravel Outline**: Adds an outline to them so you can spot them more easily 
- **Bluer Blue Ice**: Makes blue ice more blue so you can differentiate it from normal ice

If you have any ideas, suggestions, problems, etc dm me on Discord (haijust)
